_comment: Product-side source policy for a deployed Odoo release.
The allow list names declarative descriptors, model definitions and authored frontend
source used by compiled facts and language-neutral repository retrieval. The deny list
excludes credentials, demo and seed data, translations, vendored/built frontend assets,
unrelated data and tests regardless of an allowed parent path; authored access-control
declarations remain searchable as release-bound source evidence. The
deployment supplies the matching source root and the exact release identity.
Paths follow the upstream odoo/odoo layout: ordinary modules live under addons/, and
base lives under odoo/addons/base. A deployment that extracts them from a container
image must reproduce that layout so citations resolve against the public repository.
